name: dlfs_write
description: Write text content to a file in a DLFS drive. Creates the file if it does not exist; overwrites if it does. Parent directories must already exist — use dlfs_mkdir first if needed. Returns the number of bytes written and whether the file was newly created.

drive.description: Drive name, or a DID-URL reference to another user's drive (e.g. 'did:key:zOwner.../drive')

content.description: Text content to write to the file

ucans.description: Optional UCAN JWT proofs authorising delegated access to another user's drive
